verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's own CLI documents running a Scrapy-project spider through `scrapingbee crawl`, so Scrapy integration is a first-party capability, though it is shown in only a single thin mention. Proxy mode is an alternate transport for the HTML API, but the docs never tie it to automation libraries, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: any documented integration with Playwright, Puppeteer, or Selenium (e.g. remote browser/CDP endpoint or SDK plugins), in-depth Scrapy integration docs (middleware/SDK), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build scrapers using popular open-source automation libraries like Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or Scrapy

citations.quote: `scrapingbee crawl` | Quick same-domain crawl, sitemap crawl, or Scrapy-project spider.
